4031120.desc: Rebound in Sleepywood and set properly for the first time in years. Most of the ink has come back. One entry runs the entire length of the book, front to back, and it is the one the rain hit hardest.

4031142.name: Elda's Last Message
4031142.desc: Elda's name-charm, wrapped in Daniel the Scholar's written copy of the message on its back.

4031143.name: Alston's Ledger Page

4031144.name: Untainted Mushroom Cap
